_doc: cloud-android-density-guard policy: the fleet's Compose hosts are dense and own window insets ONCE. Everything the guard knows is here. scan_roots: the apps and libs the Compose conversion reached; a legacy Compose app with its own Typography (Writer, Gallery, Drive, Search) is outside.

bare_material_theme.why: MaterialTheme(colorScheme = ...) without typography = kitTypography() hands every Text a fixed 24.sp bodyLarge line and every Material control a 48dp floor: the 'huge padding' after the Compose conversions. Use CloudKitTheme or KitDenseMaterial; an app with its own Typography names `typography =`.

scaffold_without_insets.why: Scaffold applies WindowInsets.systemBars to its content by default; inside a host that already clears the bars (FleetChrome + AppTopBarScaffold / BottomNavHost) that is a second copy of the same padding. Pass contentWindowInsets = WindowInsets(0) or the one slice you own.

nested_safe_drawing.why: safeDrawing / systemBars padding is the window host's job exactly once (AppTopBarScaffold's host takes statusBarsPadding; BottomNavHost clears the bottom). A page that takes it again stacks both.
